name: Llwch Llawwyanawc
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Llwch Llawwyanawc is a small figure in Welsh legend. The source calls him a Welsh hero who carried a flaming sword. With it he guided king ARTHUR into the gray realm of the OTHERWORLD. His name is also met as Llwch Lleminawc and Llwch Llenllawc. The tales keep him as a minor character.

okr.objective: Record the minor Welsh hero Llwch Llawwyanawc.
key_results: Give his flaming sword and his guiding of Arthur.
Note the alternate names of the hero.
